title: Book Two · Chapter 40: Jobs by the Shelf
story:
On Friday, Miss Wu asks the class about the reading shelf.

Some books are lying flat. Two books are on the floor. A small pile is on the wrong side. One empty card is left on a desk.

“We need help here each week,” she says.

Leo puts his hand up. So does Ronan. Mei finishes her line of writing, then raises hers.

“Not only reading,” Miss Wu says. “There are books to put back and names to write down. We need a clear path too.”

“Can I look after all of it?” Ronan asks.

Miss Wu looks at the row of books.

“We will share the jobs. First, I need to see the pages with each of you on Monday. Then I can arrange the work.”

Ronan lowers his hand slowly.

“Is it for the best readers?” Leo asks.

“It is for the class. A good reader can still put a book in the wrong place.”

Jun points at Leo's elbow. It is resting on the empty card.

Leo lifts his arm.

“This one came to me.”

“Give it back,” Jun says.

Leo brings the card to Miss Wu. Ronan picks up two books from the floor. He checks the covers and puts them beside the shelf.

The train book is there. Its repaired page is still firm. He remembers the first loose edge. He and Leo can both find the station picture now.

At lunch, he sits beside Jun outside.

“Will you ask for a job?” he says.

“Perhaps the books. I like putting the same sizes together.”

“I could write the names.”

Jun finishes his mouthful.

“You can ask.”

Ronan looks towards the classroom. He wants to stand beside Miss Wu and take the first book. He imagines Leo at the other end of the desk.

Miss Wu will give them jobs on Monday.

They play with the cloth ball after lunch. Mei passes with a friend. She asks them to move the goal farther from the flower pots.

Ronan picks up one bag. Jun moves the other. Leo rolls the ball through the new gap.

“Too easy.”

“Then stand back,” Ronan says.

Leo takes three large steps and misses. The ball lands beside his own shoe.

On the way home, Ronan carries his bag on both shoulders. The weekend is beginning. Dad will still have work tomorrow.

At the gate, Mr Qiu asks him to move an empty pencil box from the dry side of the table to the shelf. Ronan puts it carefully between two larger boxes.

“Like a little school library,” he says.

“Except these pencils are for sale.”

“I know.”

Mr Qiu gives him the loose lid. Ronan fits it on the small box before he leaves.

At home, he finds the monthly reading-room note in his tea box. He looks at the price once, then folds it again. No new money goes beside it today.

Mum calls him to wash for dinner. He closes the box and goes to the kitchen. He will speak to Miss Wu on Monday.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

arrange＝安排；firm＝牢固的；mouthful＝一口食物；monthly＝每月的。

## 理解问题

1. Miss Wu准备怎样安排借阅角的工作？
2. Ronan目前是否已经得到登记名字的任务？

## 读句子

We / will share / the jobs.＝我们／会分担／这些工作。
